question.prompt: A cylinder can be viewed as the solid formed by:

solutions.explanation: Rotating a rectangle about one side produces a cylinder. Rotating a right triangle produces a cone, and rotating a semicircle produces a sphere.
solutions.title: Recognizing solids formed by rotation
